dismissed_comment: Pattern source is the user-configured regex in private ayuless_filters preferences; incoming messages are match input. Regex syntax is intentional. This does not assert that user patterns are immune to excessive backtracking.

ContactsController builds this IN list exclusively from values escaped with DatabaseUtils.appendEscapedSQLString, including existing contact keys. The concatenated SQL does not interpolate unescaped lookup keys.

The ZIP name is reduced to its basename with lastIndexOf("/") before createFileInCache; only .txt entries are accepted. The output parent is the fixed sharing cache. ZIP directory components cannot reach the output path on Android.

AnimationNotificationsLocker is a NotificationCenter animation token, not a thread mutex. It is released through animation completion/state callbacks outside the lock() scope. Corresponding completion paths were reviewed; cancellation behavior is not generally certified.

MD5 computes the Telegram encrypted-upload fingerprint from the random AES key and IV, then XORs digest bytes. It is not password hashing or a standalone integrity check. Replacing this algorithm unilaterally breaks protocol compatibility.
